name: Roshutsu-Kei Mahou Joshi Daisei Christhea
original_name: 露出系魔法女子大生クリスティア
source:
Touka, a 19 year old college girl is looking forward to a new life in college. She hopes to make friends with the girls and find a boyfriend. She carries a secret however, a love for masturbation and dildos. While masturbating with a new dildo she received from overseas she's recorded by her childhood friend Kokoha. It turns out Kokoha is a magical girl, the magical girl Tear Heart!

Kokoha's magic comes from embarrassment energy, or S Energy from the heart of a shy maiden. However, Kokoha isn't shy at all! She demands Touka become a magical girl so she can collect the S Energy for both of them. She blackmails Touka by showing the video of her masturbating to everyone at school until Touka agrees. Touka becomes Magical Jousei Christea and helps Tear Heart fight Libido. She isn't really needed though for anything but collecting S Energy!

An RPG adventure with a map system. Choose the clothes for Touka to wear around town. When losing a battle against a Libido a new outfit can be given as the Libido forces her to wear clothes according to their fetish. Choose what she will wear, from shy and cute college girl to naked wearing nothing but a ribbon around her neck and anything in between. Maids, transparent nightgowns, school swimsuits, dog collars, there's plenty of fetishes to enjoy. The more embarrassing the outfit the more S Energy you'll earn.
